title: create_receipt
x-feature-056-note: Relaxes original_internal_morning_id from required to optional. When present, this contract is byte-for-byte the existing post-Feature-027/bugfix-028 behavior (x-when-linked below) - unchanged. When absent, this is a NEW standalone-receipt branch (x-when-standalone below), one tool with two branches, per Clarification Q1 (spec.md) - not a separate MCP tool.

original_internal_morning_id.description: Morning document id of the invoice being paid. Must resolve to a type-305 document whose client sub-object has a real id, or this tool refuses (REQ-INV-013/016).

payment_date.description: The real date the money moved, ISO YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Required (bugfix-028 A3).

amount.description: Optional override - defaults to the original's full total.

oneOf.x-client-resolution: resolve_client_name-then-name_resolved (same architecture as create_invoice/create_transaction_account/create_combo_document, per bugfix-028's client-resolution rewrite)

client_name.description: The client's exact, already-resolved name (caller must have called resolve_client_name first and pass name_resolved=True) - REQ-INV-015.

name_resolved.description: Must be True or this refuses immediately, attempting no Morning lookup at all - same contract as create_invoice.

amount.description: The receipt amount (no default to derive from, since there is no original document) - REQ-INV-015.

description.description: Free-text Hebrew description composed by the model (e.g. 'פיקדון', 'החזר הלוואה', 'מקדמה על חשבון...') - no structured reason code (REQ-INV-018, Clarification Q2).

payment_date.description: The real date the money moved, ISO YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Required, same _validate_payment_date reuse as every other payment-carrying tool.

oneOf.x-payload-shape: type 400, no income/VAT line, linkedDocumentIds always [], client={self:false,id:<resolved_client.id>} - see data-model.md
oneOf.x-out-of-scope: No linkedDocumentIds correlation to a later invoice (Clarification Q3, REQ-INV-019) - the standalone receipt and any later real invoice for the same transaction are fully independent documents.

x-audit: log_mutation on success (both branches); log_refusal when name_resolved is not True or the client doesn't resolve exactly - same pattern as every other create_* tool.
